name: cn-family-law-expert-suite
description: 面向中国大陆婚姻家事法律工作的端到端专家套件，覆盖分轮访谈、事实证据账本、财产债务与子女方案、现行法规和类案检索、婚前及婚内财产协议、离婚协议、同居协议、分家析产协议、成年意定监护协议、正式文档生成与法律质检。正式法律成果须经中国大陆执业律师实质复核批准。
descriptionEn: An end-to-end expert suite for Mainland China family-law work, covering staged intake, fact and evidence ledgers, asset, debt and parenting analysis, current-law and case research, six configurable agreement workflows, formal document generation, and legal quality control. Formal legal deliverables require substantive review and approval by a qualified Mainland China lawyer.
